volt-id.title:
VOLT ID - One Account
For Everything
volt-id.desc:
Create a VOLT ID and the
entire app becomes available:
one-click payment, easy
wallet connection, and
participation in exclusive
token giveaways

desc.title: We looked around...
desc.desc:
Flat is too flat (yeah,
too flat) and boring.
Neumorphism is
unwieldy in reality.
minimorphism design
system - is the middle
ground. A design
language built on
Physics, Material, and
Light

objects.title: Everything is an Object
objects.desc:
No flat drawings or fake depth. Every button, card, and
input is a solid physical object lying on a surface. You
don't just see the UI - you feel its weight

materials.title: Three Materials. Zer0 Noise
materials.first-desc:
True Black - The
depth of space.
Backgrounds &
active energy
materials.third-desc:
Anodized Graphite
- Tactile industrial
metal for
secondary layers

light.title: Sculpted with Light, Soft by Geometry
light.desc:
No fake color gradients. Volume is created purely with
physical light and inner shadows. Soft rounded shapes
contrast with a steel display typeface.
